name: @reclose/evidence-builder
description: C3: builds and validates the Evidence Artifact Package (EAP) JSON string the Judge's submit_incident/submit_remediation/submit_recovery_validation expect, mirroring contracts/incident_judge_v1.py::_valid_source_url/_parse_and_validate_eap's deterministic bounds client-side for fast-fail UX (CLAUDE.md Section 15). The Judge remains the sole authority on acceptance - this package never accepts something the Judge would reject, and documents every bound's on-chain origin so the two never silently drift.
